protocol.purpose: Test whether the lower emitted synthesis reasoning observed in the composed Fieldnote workload repeats on CUDA, including a shared-prefix HTTP control.
protocol.workload: Full Fieldnote Survey, Standard effort, fresh session/coverage, original Harbor PDF and site map plus Markdown corpus, four reviewed objectives, saved brief and follow-up. Route-explicit question is identical to the completed CUDA memory composed workload.

armMeaning.resident: Pinned Fieldnote orchestration with public Branch sampler settings at stage boundaries; resident trunk/spine and ordinary native abilities.
armMeaning.http: Existing idiomatic LangGraph host behind the same Fieldnote UI, cache_prompt=true, llama-server prefix-cache enabled.
armMeaning.shared-prefix: The same HTTP host and workflow: stable system brief/catalog and tool schema, with complete original stage instructions and adjacent text/images grouped in the user turn. Synthesis retains the research tool schema with stock tool_choice=none. Natural prefix-cache reuse; no synthetic padding or hidden priming.

seeds.preflight: 2000 + source index, fixed by pinned coverage API

controls.gpu: one NVIDIA L40S; stacks run sequentially
controls.tracing: Native LLOYAL_DEV=1, instrumented native and server binaries from previous CUDA experiment
controls.outputCap: No explicit synthesis cap on either path; retain context/output-limit failures

protocol.order: Random initial arm permutation, cyclic rotation per repetition; one occurrence in each position. Save realized order before any measured run.
acceptance: Fresh preflight and synthesis events present
Four reviewed inquiry objectives retained with original routing
Model/projector/reranker and pinned runtime identities saved
HTTP exact requests, rendered prompts, SSE and cache receipts retained
Shared-prefix synthesis has nonzero server-reported cache_n, with reusable token-prefix evidence
outcomes: Emitted reasoning tokens by stage, post-hoc same GGUF tokenizer
Visible final answer tokens and words
Per-stage generation totals and wall time
Synthesis and workload HTTP prefix-cache reuse
Rubric-scored initial answer and separate follow-up
protocol.interpretation: Three repetitions of one synthetic task are exploratory. Full inputs and generated evidence differ. Shared-prefix layout is an input-construction intervention, not a pure cache on/off ablation. Matching sampler settings does not make different execution paths bitwise identical. Reasoning text is not a measure of all internal computation. No causal or quality-equivalence claim from token counts alone. The shared-prefix variant changes instruction placement from system to user and retains the research tool schema at synthesis; its synthesis system prompt is therefore not byte-identical to the other two arms. Original stage instruction text is preserved.
protocol.failurePolicy: Retain every pilot, completed attempt and failure. No unrecorded automatic replacement. Pilot repairs precede a new protocol/source freeze; results with missing acceptance receipts remain ineligible.

pilotAcceptance.resident: pilot-resident-v1: full UI journey complete; stage samplers applied through public Branch API
pilotAcceptance.shared-prefix: pilot-shared-prefix-v2: full UI journey complete; synthesis cache_n=1788, prompt_n=3786; seven tool schemas retained with tool_choice=none
pilotAcceptance.retainedFailure: pilot-shared-prefix-v1: full UI completed but synthesis cache_n=0; shared prefix inside changing system message lacked a reusable recurrent checkpoint

nativePatch.scope: Explicit public Branch sampler settings at stage boundaries; inquiry seed offset. No orchestration, evidence, prompt or budget edits. Preflight agent seeds stay 2000+i, as in the pinned coverage API.
